name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.8.3
body:
- New **IR Send Rules**
  - Send IR codes based on Current Profile, Video Input/Output, RetroTink Power, http gameID, and other HDMI metadata.
  - Use the Rules to turn on/off devices or change options on your receiver.
  - Requires having the IR Blaster connected on the Donut Dongle
  - Ability to Learn (capture) and Test IR codes
- Remotes are more responsive and support holding down directional buttons to move quickly.
   - Directional buttons are now 50% larger for ease of use. Matches the size of the OSD overlay buttons.
   - Note: OSD Mirror does not refresh while directional buttons are being held.
- IR Remote now kicks into "turbo" mode when continuing to hold down directional buttons.
- Memory optimizations
